items.question: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
items.answer:
Card machine POS-GS-99812 (Get Smart): connectivity status OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT; mobile data: Dual-SIM 4G session stalled; Wi-Fi: Wi-Fi interface disabled.

Internal troubleshooting guidance (not published Getnet policy): OFFLINE_GPRS_TIMEOUT means the terminal's mobile data session stalled. First-line steps for the merchant, in order: 1) restart the terminal and wait for the network indicator; 2) if Wi-Fi is available, connect the terminal to the store Wi-Fi; 3) with the terminal off, reseat the SIM chip and power it back on; 4) run the communication test described in the Getnet FAQ. If the terminal is still offline on both mobile data and Wi-Fi after these steps, open a ticket with a human specialist for a chip or terminal swap.
Get Clássica card machine (maquininha): The Get Clássica is described on the Getnet site as a "Maquininha POS 3G + Wi-Fi": a POS card machine that connects over 3G mobile data and Wi-Fi.

Sources: internal://support-runbook, https://site.getnet.com.br/maquininha/get-classica/
